title: The World Design of Dark Souls | Boss Keys
speaker: Game Maker's Toolkit
zh: 【Game Maker's Toolkit】黑暗靈魂的世界設計|老闆鑰匙（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: There are a lot of memorable moments in Dark Souls, but there’s one very specific part
cues.en: There are a lot of memorable moments in Dark Souls, but there’s one very specific part
cues.zh: 《黑暗靈魂》中有很多令人難忘的時刻，但有一個非常特殊的部分

cues.text: that stuck out for me.
cues.en: that stuck out for me.
cues.zh: 這對我來說很突出。

cues.text: After arriving in Firelink Shrine, you venture into the Undead Berg, fight the Taurus Demon
cues.en: After arriving in Firelink Shrine, you venture into the Undead Berg, fight the Taurus Demon
cues.zh: 到達傳火神殿後，冒險進入亡靈山，與金牛惡魔戰鬥

cues.text: on the bridge, narrowly avoid getting roasted alive by a dragon, find your way to the Undead
cues.en: on the bridge, narrowly avoid getting roasted alive by a dragon, find your way to the Undead
cues.zh: 在橋上，我差點被龍活活烤死，找到通往亡靈的路

cues.text: Parish, fight past giant soldiers in the church, take this random elevator down, and arrive
cues.en: Parish, fight past giant soldiers in the church, take this random elevator down, and arrive
cues.zh: 教區，與教堂裡的巨型士兵戰鬥，乘坐這個隨機電梯下來，到達

cues.text: all the way back at… Firelink Shrine.
cues.en: all the way back at… Firelink Shrine.
cues.zh: 一路回到……傳火神社。

cues.text: It’s at this moment you realise that the world of Dark Souls is very different to most
cues.en: It’s at this moment you realise that the world of Dark Souls is very different to most
cues.zh: 正是在這一刻，你意識到《黑暗靈魂》的世界與大多數世界有很大不同

cues.text: other games.
cues.en: other games.
cues.zh: 其他遊戲。

cues.text: It’s not a linear series of zones - but a complex, maze-like world that branches off
cues.en: It’s not a linear series of zones - but a complex, maze-like world that branches off
cues.zh: 它不是一系列線性區域 - 而是一個複雜的、迷宮般的分支世界

cues.text: into different areas, then loops back around on itself through shortcuts and elevators.
cues.en: into different areas, then loops back around on itself through shortcuts and elevators.
cues.zh: 進入不同的區域，然後透過捷徑和電梯自行迴圈返回。

cues.text: It seems to snap together like a fancy 3D jigsaw puzzle, and exploring this world feels
cues.en: It seems to snap together like a fancy 3D jigsaw puzzle, and exploring this world feels
cues.zh: 它似乎像一個奇特的 3D 拼圖一樣拼湊在一起，探索這個世界的感覺

cues.text: like navigating a Metroid map, or a Zelda dungeon.
cues.en: like navigating a Metroid map, or a Zelda dungeon.
cues.zh: 就像在銀河戰士地圖或薩爾達地下城中導航一樣。

cues.text: Which is why I’m dedicating this special spin-off episode of Boss Keys to the world
cues.en: Which is why I’m dedicating this special spin-off episode of Boss Keys to the world
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我將《Boss Keys》的這部特別衍生劇獻給全世界

cues.text: of Dark Souls 1.
cues.en: of Dark Souls 1.
cues.zh: 黑暗靈魂1.

cues.text: I’m going to be looking at how this world is put together, the advantages and disadvantages
cues.en: I’m going to be looking at how this world is put together, the advantages and disadvantages
cues.zh: 我將研究這個世界是如何組成的，優點和缺點

cues.text: of non-linear world design, and how Dark Souls has even more in common with Zelda than you
cues.en: of non-linear world design, and how Dark Souls has even more in common with Zelda than you
cues.zh: 非線性世界設計，以及《黑暗靈魂》與《薩爾達》的共同點比你更多

cues.text: might think.
cues.en: might think.
cues.zh: 可能會想。

cues.text: So, buckle up and come with me, Mark Brown, on a journey to the fantasy kingdom of Lordran.
cues.en: So, buckle up and come with me, Mark Brown, on a journey to the fantasy kingdom of Lordran.
cues.zh: 所以，繫好安全帶，和我馬克布朗一起踏上前往洛德蘭奇幻王國的旅程。

cues.text: To start, we should identify the basic structure of Dark Souls.
cues.en: To start, we should identify the basic structure of Dark Souls.
cues.zh: 首先，我們應該要確定《黑暗靈魂》的基本結構。

cues.text: And I think this game fits quite neatly into five distinct acts.
cues.en: And I think this game fits quite neatly into five distinct acts.
cues.zh: 我認為這款遊戲非常適合五個不同的行為。

cues.text: There’s the intro, in the Undead Asylum, where we learn the ropes and defeat the first
cues.en: There’s the intro, in the Undead Asylum, where we learn the ropes and defeat the first
cues.zh: 簡介是在亡靈庇護所，我們在那裡學習訣竅並擊敗了第一個

cues.text: boss: the Asylum Demon.
cues.en: boss: the Asylum Demon.
cues.zh: 首領：庇護惡魔。

cues.text: Then, for act two, we’re in Lordran proper and must ring the two bells of awakening.
cues.en: Then, for act two, we’re in Lordran proper and must ring the two bells of awakening.
cues.zh: 然後，在第二幕中，我們在洛德蘭本土，必須敲響兩聲覺醒的鐘聲。

cues.text: One can be found after we fight the Bell Gargoyles on top of the Undead Parish, and the other
cues.en: One can be found after we fight the Bell Gargoyles on top of the Undead Parish, and the other
cues.zh: 一個可以在我們與不死教區頂部的貝爾石像鬼戰鬥後找到，另一個

cues.text: is behind Quelaag, down in Blighttown.
cues.en: is behind Quelaag, down in Blighttown.
cues.zh: 位於克拉格後面，位於布萊特敦。

cues.text: You can do these in either order, but most first time players will do the church first.
cues.en: You can do these in either order, but most first time players will do the church first.
cues.zh: 你可以按任意順序完成這些任務，但大多數初次玩家會先完成教堂。

cues.text: Then, for act three, it’s off to Sen’s Fortress - which is a sort of nightmare funhouse.
cues.en: Then, for act three, it’s off to Sen’s Fortress - which is a sort of nightmare funhouse.
cues.zh: 然後，在第三幕中，我們將前往森的堡壘——這是一個噩夢般的遊樂園。

cues.text: And then we head to Anor Londo, where we fight Ornstein and Smough, and receive the Lordvessel.
cues.en: And then we head to Anor Londo, where we fight Ornstein and Smough, and receive the Lordvessel.
cues.zh: 然後我們前往亞諾爾隆多，在那裡我們與奧恩斯坦和斯莫戰鬥，並接收了領主容器。

cues.text: Now, in act four, the game tasks you with retrieving the four Lord Souls.
cues.en: Now, in act four, the game tasks you with retrieving the four Lord Souls.
cues.zh: 現在，在第四幕中，遊戲的任務是找回四個靈魂領主。

cues.text: These are collected by defeating bosses who are found in new areas - but ones that are
cues.en: These are collected by defeating bosses who are found in new areas - but ones that are
cues.zh: 這些是透過擊敗在新區域發現的 Boss 來收集的 - 但那些是

cues.text: just off from places you may have visited before: there’s Gravelord Nito in the Valley
cues.en: just off from places you may have visited before: there’s Gravelord Nito in the Valley
cues.zh: 離您以前可能去過的地方不遠：山谷裡有墳墓領主尼託 (Gravelord Nito)

cues.text: of the Giants, Seath the Scaleless in Duke’s Archives, the Four Kings in New Londo Ruins,
cues.en: of the Giants, Seath the Scaleless in Duke’s Archives, the Four Kings in New Londo Ruins,
cues.zh: 巨人王、杜克檔案館中的無鱗者西斯、新倫敦廢墟中的四王，

cues.text: and The Bed of Chaos in Lost Izaleth.
cues.en: and The Bed of Chaos in Lost Izaleth.
cues.zh: 以及《失落的伊澤拉斯》中的混沌之床。

cues.text: These often have other bosses along the way, like Sif and Pinwheel, and all of this can
cues.en: These often have other bosses along the way, like Sif and Pinwheel, and all of this can
cues.zh: 一路上它們通常還有其他 Boss，例如 Sif 和 Pinwheel，而所有這些都可以

cues.text: be done in absolutely any order you like.
cues.en: be done in absolutely any order you like.
cues.zh: 絕對可以按照您喜歡的任何順序完成。

cues.text: When you’ve got all four, it’s on to the final area and the last boss, Gwyn: Lord of
cues.en: When you’ve got all four, it’s on to the final area and the last boss, Gwyn: Lord of
cues.zh: 當你獲得全部四個後，就進入了最後一個區域和最後一個 Boss，格溫：領主

cues.text: Cinder, for act five.
cues.en: Cinder, for act five.
cues.zh: Cinder，第五幕。

cues.text: So, I think this works really nicely.
cues.en: So, I think this works really nicely.
cues.zh: 所以，我認為這非常有效。

cues.text: Acts 1, 3, and 5 are very linear and have a sense of forward momentum to them.
cues.en: Acts 1, 3, and 5 are very linear and have a sense of forward momentum to them.
cues.zh: 第一幕、第三幕和第五幕非常線性，有一種前進的動力。

cues.text: While acts 2 and 4 are more open, and branching.
cues.en: While acts 2 and 4 are more open, and branching.
cues.zh: 而第二幕和第四幕則更加開放和分支。

cues.text: It’s an accordion like structure that is actually… very familiar.
cues.en: It’s an accordion like structure that is actually… very familiar.
cues.zh: 這是一個類似手風琴的結構，實際上……非常熟悉。

cues.text: You see, the basic outline of Dark Souls is near identical to the basic outline… of
cues.en: You see, the basic outline of Dark Souls is near identical to the basic outline… of
cues.zh: 你看，《黑暗靈魂》的基本輪廓幾乎與…的基本輪廓相同。

cues.text: Zelda: A Link to the Past.
cues.en: Zelda: A Link to the Past.
cues.zh: 薩爾達：眾神的三角力量。

cues.text: In that game there’s an intro, and then some early dungeons that can be done out of order.
cues.en: In that game there’s an intro, and then some early dungeons that can be done out of order.
cues.zh: 在那款遊戲中有一個介紹，然後是一些可以亂序完成的早期地下城。

cues.text: Then the path constricts for Hyrule Castle, but then branches out widely as you re-explore
cues.en: Then the path constricts for Hyrule Castle, but then branches out widely as you re-explore
cues.zh: 然後通往海拉魯城堡的道路會變窄，但當你重新探索時，道路會變得更寬。

cues.text: old areas, now with access to the dark world, to tackle the tougher dungeons in largely
cues.en: old areas, now with access to the dark world, to tackle the tougher dungeons in largely
cues.zh: 舊區域現在可以進入黑暗世界，可以在很大程度上解決更困難的地下城

cues.text: whatever order you like.
cues.en: whatever order you like.
cues.zh: 無論你喜歡什麼順序。

cues.text: Then the path constricts one final time for the battle against Ganon.
cues.en: Then the path constricts one final time for the battle against Ganon.
cues.zh: 然後，為了與加農的戰鬥，道路最後一次收縮。

cues.text: Perhaps it’s not surprising, given how Souls creator Hidetaka Miyazaki has spoken about
cues.en: Perhaps it’s not surprising, given how Souls creator Hidetaka Miyazaki has spoken about
cues.zh: 考慮到靈魂創作者宮崎英高的說法，這也許並不奇怪

cues.text: his admiration for the Zelda series, but I think it’s a very interesting parallel nonetheless.
cues.en: his admiration for the Zelda series, but I think it’s a very interesting parallel nonetheless.
cues.zh: 他對薩爾達系列的欽佩，但我認為這仍然是一個非常有趣的相似之處。

cues.text: But then again, while this does describe the path that most players take - this isn’t
cues.en: But then again, while this does describe the path that most players take - this isn’t
cues.zh: 但話又說回來，雖然這確實描述了大多數玩家所採取的道路，但事實並非如此

cues.text: a completely accurate portrayal of how Dark Souls is laid out.
cues.en: a completely accurate portrayal of how Dark Souls is laid out.
cues.zh: 完全準確地描繪了《黑暗靈魂》的佈局方式。

cues.text: You can actually do lots of stuff out of order.
cues.en: You can actually do lots of stuff out of order.
cues.zh: 實際上你可以不按順序做很多事情。

cues.text: You can kill Pinwheel at any time after arriving in Lordran, you can kill Sif and the Four
cues.en: You can kill Pinwheel at any time after arriving in Lordran, you can kill Sif and the Four
cues.zh: 到達Lordran後你可以隨時殺死Pinwheel，你可以殺死Sif和四個人

cues.text: Kings before ever visiting Anor Londo, and you can kill the Ceaseless Discharge as soon
cues.en: Kings before ever visiting Anor Londo, and you can kill the Ceaseless Discharge as soon
cues.zh: 國王在訪問亞諾爾隆多之前，你可以盡快殺死不斷放電

cues.text: as you’ve finished off Quelaag.
cues.en: as you’ve finished off Quelaag.
cues.zh: 因為你已經完成克拉格了。

cues.text: And you can skip some of these bosses entirely.
cues.en: And you can skip some of these bosses entirely.
cues.zh: 你可以完全跳過其中一些老闆。

cues.text: If you take a secret route to Blighttown through Darkroot Basin, you can skip the Capra Demon
cues.en: If you take a secret route to Blighttown through Darkroot Basin, you can skip the Capra Demon
cues.zh: 如果你透過暗根盆地走一條秘密路線前往枯萎鎮，你可以跳過卡普拉惡魔

cues.text: and the Gaping Dragon.
cues.en: and the Gaping Dragon.
cues.zh: 和張開的龍。

cues.text: If you help out Solaire you can skip the Demon Firesage and the Centipede Demon.
cues.en: If you help out Solaire you can skip the Demon Firesage and the Centipede Demon.
cues.zh: 如果你幫助索萊爾，你就可以跳過惡魔火賢者和蜈蚣惡魔。

cues.text: And if you choose the Master Key as your initial gift, you can even dodge the Taurus Demon.
cues.en: And if you choose the Master Key as your initial gift, you can even dodge the Taurus Demon.
cues.zh: 如果你選擇萬能鑰匙作為你的初始禮物，你甚至可以躲避金牛座惡魔。

cues.text: There sure a lot of Demons in this game.
cues.en: There sure a lot of Demons in this game.
cues.zh: 這個遊戲裡肯定有很多惡魔。

cues.text: They should have called it Demon’s Sou...oh wait.
cues.en: They should have called it Demon’s Sou...oh wait.
cues.zh: 他們應該稱之為惡魔之魂……喔等等。

cues.text: Uh, plus, there are also four entirely optional bosses - Moonlight butterfly, Stray Demon, Crossbreed
cues.en: Uh, plus, there are also four entirely optional bosses - Moonlight butterfly, Stray Demon, Crossbreed
cues.zh: 呃，另外，還有四個完全可選的 Boss——月光蝴蝶、流浪惡魔、雜種

cues.text: Priscila, and Dark Sun Gwyndolin - that have no impact on the structure of the game whatsoever.
cues.en: Priscila, and Dark Sun Gwyndolin - that have no impact on the structure of the game whatsoever.
cues.zh: Priscila 和 Dark Sun Gwyndolin - 對遊戲的結構沒有任何影響。

cues.text: They just give you cool goodies.
cues.en: They just give you cool goodies.
cues.zh: 他們只是給你很酷的東西。

cues.text: So the structure of Dark Souls really looks more like… this.
cues.en: So the structure of Dark Souls really looks more like… this.
cues.zh: 所以《黑暗靈魂》的結構看起來更像是……這樣。

cues.text: Not quite as attractive, is it? But it’s a good visual reminder that Dark Souls is
cues.en: Not quite as attractive, is it? But it’s a good visual reminder that Dark Souls is
cues.zh: 不太有吸引力，是嗎？但這是一個很好的視覺提醒，黑暗靈魂是

cues.text: a game with lots of branching paths.
cues.en: a game with lots of branching paths.
cues.zh: 一個有很多分支路徑的遊戲。

cues.text: Like, when you get to the Undead Parish you can explore the church, or go fight the Moonlight
cues.en: Like, when you get to the Undead Parish you can explore the church, or go fight the Moonlight
cues.zh: 就像，當你到達亡靈教區時，你可以探索教堂，或對抗月光

cues.text: Butterfly in Darkroot Garden, or fight this hydra in Darkroot Basin, or go off into the
cues.en: Butterfly in Darkroot Garden, or fight this hydra in Darkroot Basin, or go off into the
cues.zh: 在暗根花園中與蝴蝶戰鬥，或在暗根盆地與這隻九頭蛇戰鬥，或進入暗根盆地

cues.text: Lower Undead Berg and explore from there.
cues.en: Lower Undead Berg and explore from there.
cues.zh: 降低亡靈山並從那裡探索。

cues.text: And right from the very beginning of the game, in Firelink Shrine, the player is expected
cues.en: And right from the very beginning of the game, in Firelink Shrine, the player is expected
cues.zh: 從遊戲一開始，在傳火神殿中，玩家就被期待著

cues.text: to travel up to the Undead Berg but you can, instead, head to the Catacombs, or New Londo Ruins.
cues.en: to travel up to the Undead Berg but you can, instead, head to the Catacombs, or New Londo Ruins.
cues.zh: 前往亡靈山，但您也可以前往地下墓穴或新隆多廢墟。

cues.text: All of this gives Dark Souls a very liberating and adventurous feeling.
cues.en: All of this gives Dark Souls a very liberating and adventurous feeling.
cues.zh: 所有這些都為《黑暗靈魂》帶來了一種非常自由和冒險的感覺。

cues.text: You rarely get the sense that you’re on a predetermined path - but, instead, you’lre
cues.en: You rarely get the sense that you’re on a predetermined path - but, instead, you’lre
cues.zh: 你很少感覺到自己正走在預定的道路上 - 但相反，你會

cues.text: making your own decisions and following your curiosity through the world.
cues.en: making your own decisions and following your curiosity through the world.
cues.zh: 做出自己的決定並跟隨你的好奇心探索世界。

cues.text: And while some of these areas are complete dead ends in terms of overall game progression,
cues.en: And while some of these areas are complete dead ends in terms of overall game progression,
cues.zh: 雖然其中一些區域在整體遊戲進展方面完全是死衚衕，

cues.text: there are often items in these late game areas that you can get early if you’re brave enough.
cues.en: there are often items in these late game areas that you can get early if you’re brave enough.
cues.zh: 如果你夠勇敢，這些後期遊戲區域通常會出現一些物品，你可以儘早獲得。

cues.text: Even a low level player can find the useful Fire Keeper Soul in New Londo Ruins.
cues.en: Even a low level player can find the useful Fire Keeper Soul in New Londo Ruins.
cues.zh: 即使是低等級玩家也可以在新隆多廢墟中找到有用的火衛靈魂。

cues.text: And then run out of there in fear.
cues.en: And then run out of there in fear.
cues.zh: 然後就帶著恐懼跑了那裡。

cues.text: That’s because the area is filled with ghosts that can’t be killed with conventional weapons.
cues.en: That’s because the area is filled with ghosts that can’t be killed with conventional weapons.
cues.zh: 這是因為該地區充滿了常規武器無法殺死的鬼魂。

cues.text: Likewise, the catacombs are filled with regenerating skeletons who will probably kill you if you’re
cues.en: Likewise, the catacombs are filled with regenerating skeletons who will probably kill you if you’re
cues.zh: 同樣，地下墓穴裡充滿了正在再生的骷髏，如果你

cues.text: at a low level.
cues.en: at a low level.
cues.zh: 處於低水平。

cues.text: But getting killed is a good way to create a lasting memory in the player’s brain.
cues.en: But getting killed is a good way to create a lasting memory in the player’s brain.
cues.zh: 但被殺是在玩家大腦中創造持久記憶的好方法。

cues.text: If you go into the Catacombs and get wrecked by skeletons, you’ll spend the next 10 hours
cues.en: If you go into the Catacombs and get wrecked by skeletons, you’ll spend the next 10 hours
cues.zh: 如果你進入地下墓穴並被骷髏擊毀，你將在接下來的 10 小時內度過

cues.text: of the game thinking about coming back to tackle that area when you’re at a higher level.
cues.en: of the game thinking about coming back to tackle that area when you’re at a higher level.
cues.zh: 當你處於更高水平時，你會考慮回來解決該領域的問題。

cues.text: Which is handy - because that’s where one of the four lords is hiding.
cues.en: Which is handy - because that’s where one of the four lords is hiding.
cues.zh: 這很方便——因為那是四位領主之一藏身的地方。

cues.text: Now, as i said before, Lordran doesn’t just branch out but it also loops back on itself, with
cues.en: Now, as i said before, Lordran doesn’t just branch out but it also loops back on itself, with
cues.zh: 現在，正如我之前所說，Lordran 不僅會分支出來，而且還會自行迴圈，

cues.text: connecting points between many of the game’s locations.
cues.en: connecting points between many of the game’s locations.
cues.zh: 許多遊戲地點之間的連線點。
